policy: Reviewed whole-film expanded or native tall presentations from 1.33:1 to 1.90:1. Unknown IMAX tags alone do not qualify. Release-labelled Open Matte discovery is a separate configurable tier; individual files are not verified.

movies.title: Avengers: Infinity War
movies.evidence: IMAX confirms whole-film expanded presentation; Disney confirms the IMAX Enhanced home edition.

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame

movies.title: Spider-Man

movies.title: Back to the Future

Select a matching home edition; individual stream files remain unverified. Named 35mm scans are also permitted as file-unverified alternatives for this reviewed title; 35mm alone is not a global aspect-ratio rule.

movies.title: The Terminator
movies.evidence: Firsthand UHD review confirms the original 1.85 home framing. This upgrades the existing unverified Open Matte discovery to a reviewed native-tall home approval. The 2024 UHD uses an enhanced/upscaled master; 4K packaging is not a claim of native 4K detail. Individual files remain unverified.

movies.title: Clash of the Titans
movies.evidence: Firsthand reviews of the released Warner Blu-ray confirm the original 1.85 home presentation. Approval is based on that existing edition, not the forthcoming Arrow edition. Applies to the 1981 Harryhausen film only, not the 2010 remake.

movies.title: Toy Story 5
movies.evidence: Two firsthand UHD disc reviews confirm the released home edition at 1.85:1. The September 22, 2026 disc release predates this review. Native tall framing qualifies without an IMAX/Open Matte tag; no claim of native 4K rendering or file-level verification.
